values: SeedThermal + StomatalPhenotypingPipeline | 16 varieties · paired watered and drought-stressed plants · July 2026

Stomatal-complex area was 6.9% lower under drought on average, but the paired effect was not statistically clear (95% CI crosses zero; p = 0.434). Canopy temperature likewise showed no overall treatment difference (all 16 pairs: D − W = −0.15 °C; p = 0.448). After excluding the two failed thermal masks, projected plant area was provisionally higher under drought by 2,374 px² across 14 complete QC pairs (p = 0.003); this finding requires mask, geometry, and physical-scale confirmation.

Stomatal result

Drought-stressed plants averaged 757 px² (6.9%) smaller stomatal complexes, but uncertainty is substantial and both paired tests are non-significant.

Interpret as no clear treatment effect in this quality-selected sample.

Thermal result

No overall canopy-temperature difference was detected. The QC-filtered projected-area contrast is statistically strong but remains provisional because image geometry, masks, and physical scale have not been fully validated.
